mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals aggressive monetary easing, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market anticipates stimulus.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by ≥0.5pp in the prior 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate above 6.0% for three consecutive months signals accelerating economic deterioration, triggering negative equity returns as the market prices in recessionary risks and reduced corporate earnings potential.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 6.0% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals coordinated policy response to housing market collapse, generating positive equity returns as the market prices in both economic shock and subsequent stimulus.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 0.5% and FEDFUNDS declines > 0.25pp in 1 month
regime_hint: housing market crisis with policy response
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST declines > 0.5% and FEDFUNDS declines > 0.25pp in the prior 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary easing cycles (FEDFUNDS ≤ 2.0%), a decline in CPIAUCSL signals deflationary fears, triggering negative equity returns as the market prices in prolonged economic stagnation risks despite policy stimulus.
regime_hint: monetary policy easing with deflationary risk
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL declines and FEDFUNDS ≤ 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals contraction in real economic output, generating negative equity returns as the market prices in reduced corporate profitability and demand for capital goods.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 900,000 units for two consecutive months signals deepening housing market collapse, triggering negative equity returns as the market prices in systemic financial risks and reduced consumer spending.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls < 900.0 (thousands of units) for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where HOUST < 900.0 for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.0% and decline in residential credit (RSAFS) signals labor market deterioration combined with credit tightening, generating negative equity returns as the market prices in recessionary consumer spending collapse.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 6.0% and RSAFS declines > 1.0% in 1 month
regime_hint: labor market deterioration with credit tightening
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE > 6.0% and RSAFS declines > 1.0% in the prior 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL y/y > 2.5%), a decline in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals preemptive monetary easing to avoid stagflation, generating positive equity returns over 60 days as the market prices in policy stability.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL y/y inflation > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS declines > 0.25pp in 1 month
regime_hint: preemptive monetary easing to avoid stagflation
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL y/y > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS declines > 0.25pp in the prior 30 days.
